flawed_step: Lines 9–11: the day-2 value of S is calculated incorrectly.
counterexample: After the 19 residents of apartment 1 move to distinct apartments 2 through 20, those 19 apartments have 6 residents each, apartment 21 still has 5, and all others have 0. Thus S = 19*C(6,2) + C(5,2) = 19*15 + 10 = 295, not 310 as claimed in line 11.
assessment_summary: The proof contains a concrete false numerical claim in its illustrative trace. The stated post-move population gives S=295.
